name: model-download
description: Processing container for fetching a selected, previously persisted classification model checkpoint from the shared models volume and republishing it as a Task API output channel

templates.description: Copy a persisted classification model checkpoint (selected via its task_ids identifier) into the model output channel

env.name: TASK_IDS
env.description: Identifies which persisted checkpoint to fetch, as '<training-run-WORKFLOW_ID>-fold-<fold>/<model-best.pth.tar|model-end.pth.tar>' — the same value stored in the kaapana-backend's installed_models registry. Set via the TASK_IDS workflow_parameter (a 'model' UIForm-backed picker); required.

outputs.name: model
outputs.description: The selected model's config.json and single checkpoint file, consumed downstream by the preprocessing and inference tasks.
